author: Gary Franchi
title: VICTORY: Federal Settlement STOPS Biden's Social Media CENSORSHIP Machine | Next News Network
text:
Patriots just scored a massive win against the Deep State's censorship apparatus. A federal settlement has officially ended the Biden regime's illegal collusion with social media giants to silence conservative voices and suppress free speech across America.
Senator Eric Schmitt, who led the charge against this authoritarian overreach, didn't mince words about what really happened during the dark Biden years. "Biden officials at the highest levels of government tried to use Facebook, X, and YouTube as their speech police," Schmitt declared, exposing the coordinated attack on our First Amendment rights.
This settlement represents the death blow to one of the most sinister aspects of the previous administration – the systematic weaponization of Big Tech against everyday Americans who dared to question official narratives. Whether it was COVID policies, election integrity concerns, or Hunter Biden's laptop, the Biden regime worked hand-in-glove with Silicon Valley to crush dissent.
The Deep State's Censorship Playbook Exposed
The evidence was overwhelming: government officials pressuring platforms to remove posts, shadow-ban conservatives, and suppress news stories that hurt Democrats politically. This wasn't about "misinformation" – it was about raw political power and silencing opposition voices.
"This settlement ensures that never again can a corrupt administration use private companies to do their dirty work of censoring American citizens," said one legal expert familiar with the case.
President Trump's return to office has already begun dismantling the censorship infrastructure built by his predecessor. With Elon Musk leading government efficiency efforts and free speech advocates throughout the administration, Americans are finally seeing their constitutional rights restored.
The timing couldn't be more perfect. As Trump works to drain the swamp and restore constitutional governance, this settlement removes one of the Deep State's favorite weapons against We the People.
This victory belongs to every American who refused to be silenced, every patriot who stood up to Big Tech tyranny, and every conservative who kept fighting when the odds seemed impossible. The speech police have been defeated – but we must remain vigilant to ensure they never return.
